name: Assemble
desc: The two halves slide in from the sides and lock together; the white lenses light; the name rises.

name: Coin flip
desc: The icon spins in like a tossed coin, lands face up, and a glint runs across it.

name: Draw on
desc: A pen traces each shape of the icon round from the top, then the shapes fill with colour.

name: Eclipse
desc: A dark disc sits over the icon with a ring of light round it, then slides away to uncover it.

name: Fill up
desc: Each half fills like a glass, blue then cyan, with a wave on the surface; the lenses light last.

name: App tile
desc: The app's own icon tile pops up with a bounce and a soft shadow; the name slides out beside it.

name: Column drop
desc: The icon falls into place in thin columns, each on its own beat, like a picture being stacked.

name: Neon
desc: The icon is bent glass tubing that flickers on, one half then the other, and stays lit.

name: Converge
desc: A blue ghost and a cyan ghost of the icon swing in from opposite corners and land as one, with a flash.

name: Construction
desc: The geometry behind the icon is drafted first: its circle, the two cuts, the lens arcs. Then it is inked.

name: Halves part
desc: The two halves of the icon fill the frame, then part like doors; the inner edges carry the white lens.

name: Through the gap
desc: The camera dives into the gap between the icon's halves; the title waits on the far side.

name: Blueprint
desc: A drafting grid draws itself; the title is traced as an outline by a scan line, then filled.

name: Letter drop
desc: Each letter drops in on its own beat, flashing blue or cyan as it lands, then settles white.

name: Parity slices
desc: The title arrives in horizontal slices, alternate ones from the left and the right, meeting in the middle.

name: Aurora
desc: Blue and cyan light drifts below; the letters grow from hairlines to full weight inside a soft halo.

name: Halftone
desc: The title is printed in dots that swell until they join into solid letters.

name: Ripple and register
desc: Rings spread from the centre; a blue copy and a cyan copy of the title slide into register and turn white.

name: Stripe sweep
desc: A band of brand stripes sweeps across on a slant and leaves the title behind it; the kicker sits in a tag.

name: Mosaic resolve
desc: Big coloured blocks refine step by step into the title, like a picture coming in over a slow line.

name: Doors close
desc: The icon's halves close over the video like doors, then draw back to the edges to show what is next.

name: Up next card
desc: The video dims, a card slides in with the next video's name, and a bar counts down the seconds.

name: Iris out
desc: The old film iris: a circle closes on the video and the icon appears where it shut.

name: Aurora
desc: The video gives way to slow blue and cyan light; the next video's name is set large on the left.

name: Countdown ring
desc: The icon sits inside a ring that fills as the seconds run out, beside the next video's name.

name: Stripe wipe
desc: The brand stripes sweep across on a slant and wipe the video away, leaving the icon and what's next.

name: Drafting table
desc: A drafting grid fades in over the video; the next title is outlined, then inked.

name: Drifting halves
desc: Half discs in blue and cyan float slowly upward behind the next video's name.

name: Was and next
desc: The frame splits in two: the video you watched on the blue side, the next one on the cyan side, the icon on the seam.

name: Quiet close
desc: A calm fade to the icon and one line of type; a thin rule draws out under it; then all goes dark.

name: Logo and link
desc: The Construction logo card as the ending: the video goes dark, the icon is drafted and inked, then where to get it.
